plugin-until.name: Countdown board
plugin-until.description: Displays a live countdown board for dates, holidays, or time differences.

topUnits.label: Main answer units
topUnits.description: How many decomposed units to show in the main answer.

holidayCalendar.label: Holiday calendar
holidayCalendar.description: Preferred country/region (US, IN, GB, CA, US.NE, etc.). You can also search “Thanksgiving in Canada”. The selected calendar appears on the card. Some regional festivals have limited year coverage.

plugin-until.dateUnavailable: No date is available in this calendar for that year or occurrence. Try a specific year or another country. Calendar coverage varies; no date has been guessed.
plugin-until.noteDayOfDead: Celebrated November 1–2; countdown is to the first calendar day. Regional traditions vary.
plugin-until.noteSunset: Begins at local sunset on this date; countdown is to the calendar day, not an exact sunset time.
plugin-until.noteMoon: Calendar estimate; local moon sighting can change the date. Countdown is to the calendar day.
plugin-until.noteCalendar: Calendar date; local observances may differ.
